name: arch-adr-writing
description: Record the context, decision, alternatives and consequences of an architecture decision in the standard format (MADR), number and archive it, and link it to the design document. Use when making an important technical decision.

name: arch-impact-analysis
description: Identify the full impact of a change (code / data / interfaces / configuration / documentation / permissions) and produce a risk list and rollback recommendations. Use whenever a change enters the design phase or the requirement scope changes.

name: arch-nfr-design
description: Systematically identifies and designs non-functional requirements (performance/availability/security/scalability/maintainability/compliance), quantifying each metric and its verification method. Use during architecture design, once functional requirements are broadly clear.

name: arch-solution-design
description: Turn a requirement specification into a solution design and architecture decision records (ADRs) that are implementable, compliant and evolvable, covering overall design, modules/services, interfaces, data, deployment, evolution and NFR responses, and use a script to check the requirement coverage matrix. Use when entering the design phase after the G1 requirement sign-off.

name: audit-evidence
description: Ensures end-to-end traceability across "requirement -> story -> MR -> test -> change -> release -> PIR": collects artifacts, validates ID chains and evidence links, and generates an audit evidence package. Use at any gate review, release execution, or audit sampling.

name: ba-acceptance-criteria
description: Split a requirement specification into user stories, define testable Given/When/Then acceptance criteria for each story, and verify that stories are fully linked to requirement IDs (RTM). Use before the requirements are finalized, when writing acceptance criteria, and when preparing G1 review materials.

name: ba-change-impact
description: Assesses the impact of a requirement change on functionality/data/interfaces/schedule/cost/stakeholders and produces a change assessment opinion. Use when a change request or requirement adjustment is received.

name: ba-requirement-analysis
description: Turn a raw business request into a structured requirement specification that can be developed and tested, covering background, goals, scope, functional requirements, non-functional requirements, business rules, dependencies, risks and compliance notes.

name: ba-requirement-tracing
description: Maintain the requirement traceability matrix (RTM) so the full chain requirement → story → test case → test → change is traceable. Use for requirement changes, iteration planning and audit traceability checks.

name: bank-domain-payments
description: Unify the payments domain language. Provides the domain glossary, core business processes (payment / reversal / clearing / reconciliation) and regulatory constraints, and checks terminology consistency in outputs. Use for any Agent task that involves payment business.

name: change-cab-prep
description: Automatically collects and organizes CAB review materials (RFC/risk assessment/rollback plan/test report/impact analysis) and generates a review package with a key-points summary. Use when preparing materials before a CAB review.

name: change-rfc
description: Generates a compliant, complete, reviewable request for change (RFC), including type/reason/scope/impact/window/rollback/evidence links. Use once the release package is ready and before requesting a production change.

name: change-risk-assessment
description: Grades a change (low/medium/high) and gives risk and contingency conclusions, citing impact analysis and test evidence. Use when drafting an RFC.

name: change-window-scheduling
description: Schedules change windows based on change type, risk level and business impact, and detects window conflicts (business peaks/freeze periods). Use after an RFC is submitted, when scheduling the change window.

name: cobol-legacy-knowledge
description: Extract traceable business and system knowledge (the L1–L5 five-level model) from legacy AS/400 COBOL code, and convert it through an adapter layer into the formats consumed by the BA / Arch roles. Use when a requirement / design task involves a legacy system.

name: dev-api-integration
description: Ensure interface contracts are implemented correctly: contract confirmation, mock-first, integration verification, exception handling and degradation, idempotency, security hardening, observability and contract testing. Use for frontend-backend integration, cross-system interface integration and third-party integration.

name: dev-backend-service
description: Implement business logic according to the bank backend architecture standards (DDD layering, microservices): Application layer → Domain layer → Infrastructure layer, including DTO mapping, business rule traceability, unified error codes, logging and interface implementation. Use for backend service / business logic layer development tasks.

name: dev-bank-coding-standards
description: Run static checks on changed code against the bank coding standards and security baseline, classify findings as fatal / critical / major, and output a check report. Use during coding or for self-checks after coding is done.

name: dev-code-reviewer
description: Assist code review: automatically check coding standards, common defects, architecture consistency and security vulnerabilities, and produce review comments classified by severity and located to the code line. Use after the MR is submitted and before code review.

name: dev-data-sql
description: High-quality data-layer development: DDL SQL, data access layer, migration scripts (with rollback), ETL, SQL performance tuning, transactional consistency, masking/permissions and data validation. Use for table design, SQL development, data migration and ETL script development.

name: dev-frontend-ui
description: Implement frontend UIs pixel-accurately from UI designs and interaction specs: component reuse, state management, form validation, API integration, responsive layout, A11y, i18n and performance optimization. Use for frontend page / component development tasks.

name: dev-perf-optimization
description: Systematically analyzes and optimizes code performance: bottleneck location, root cause analysis, optimization design, benchmark comparison and performance regression. Use for performance fixes, dedicated performance optimization and code performance reviews.

name: dev-refactoring
description: Identifies refactoring opportunities and technical debt, plans small verifiable refactoring steps, and verifies functional equivalence afterwards. Use for technical debt cleanup, feature refactoring and code quality improvement.

name: dev-unit-test
description: Generate and run high-quality unit tests that cover normal / boundary / exception / rollback paths, and quantify coverage. Use after coding is done and before submitting the MR.

name: dev-unit-test-extended
description: Goes beyond basic unit tests: layered unit test strategy, mocking conventions, test pyramid guidance, coverage gap analysis and test smell detection. Use when writing unit tests, raising coverage or improving test quality.

name: g1-gate-execution
description: G1 requirements-phase gate runner. Runs the requirement completeness/ambiguous-word/RTM check scripts together and summarizes the results.

name: g2-gate-execution
description: G2 design-phase gate runner. Runs the requirement-design coverage matrix and ADR format checks together and summarizes the results.

name: g3-gate-execution
description: G3 development-phase gate runner. Runs the coding standards/layering/circular dependency/coverage checks together and summarizes the results.

name: g4-gate-execution
description: G4 test-phase gate runner. Runs the requirement-test case coverage and test case deduplication checks together and summarizes the results.

name: g5-gate-execution
description: G5 security-phase gate runner. Runs the vulnerability triage check and summarizes the results.

name: g6-gate-execution
description: G6 release-phase gate runner. Runs the build artifact checksum and rollback runbook completeness checks together and summarizes the results.

name: g7-gate-execution
description: G7 change-phase gate runner. Runs the RFC validation/risk grading/window scheduling checks together and summarizes the results.

name: g8-gate-execution
description: G8 governance-phase gate runner. Runs the gate collection/end-to-end traceability/SoD compliance/masking checks together and summarizes the results.

name: output-sanitization
description: Automatically scans and masks sensitive information in Agent output (phone numbers/account numbers/ID numbers/keys/IPs/production data fragments); high-severity hits block submission outright. Use before any Agent output is submitted or shared externally.

name: pm-gate-checklist
description: Ensures phase deliverables and approval status are complete, and generates gate checklists and review materials to support gate decisions across the eight G1-G8 phases of the bank delivery pipeline. Use at the end of each phase and before milestone reviews.

name: pm-risk-register
description: Risk identification, assessment (probability x impact), response, tracking and reporting across the full project lifecycle. Use for risk identification, risk tracking and risk reporting.

name: pm-status-reporting
description: Automatically aggregates project data into standardized weekly/monthly/milestone reports, flagging deviation root causes and anomalies. Use for weekly reports, monthly reports, milestone reports and status updates.

name: qa-defect-management
description: Records, classifies, tracks, verifies and reports on defects and assesses exit risk, ensuring closed-loop defect management. Use when a defect is found, for defect lifecycle management and for test exit assessment.

name: qa-integration-test
description: Ensure cross-system / cross-module integration is correct: integration scope confirmation, SIT environment planning, interface / data flow / business scenario / exception and fault tolerance / idempotency tests, and integration management. Use for designing and running multi-system / multi-module integration tests in the SIT phase.

name: qa-performance-test
description: Systematic performance testing: requirement analysis, planning, scenario design (baseline/load/stress/soak/concurrency), scripting, execution, result analysis and reporting. Use for performance test requirements, performance acceptance and reproducing performance issues.

name: qa-regression-selection
description: Smart regression test scope selection: change analysis, impact analysis, risk grading, test case selection and regression report. Use after defect fixes, after requirement changes and before version releases.

name: qa-system-test-design
description: Systematic system test case design: equivalence classes/boundary values/decision tables/state transitions/scenarios, covering functional/boundary/exception/UI/data validation, linked to requirements for 100% coverage. Use when designing test cases in the system test (ST) phase.

name: qa-test-case-design
description: Derives an executable, traceable test case set (normal/boundary/exception/regression) from requirements and acceptance criteria and links it to the RTM. Use after the test strategy is finalized.

name: qa-test-execution
description: Manages test execution progress, tracks test case execution status, and generates daily test reports and summary reports. Use during test execution and for daily test tracking.

name: qa-test-strategy
description: Defines test scope, levels (unit/integration/SIT/UAT/performance/security), environment and data strategy, and quantifiable exit criteria. Use once design is finalized and before testing starts.

name: qa-uat-support
description: Support business users through UAT: scope confirmation, scenario mapping, case review, environment and data preparation, training and support, execution tracking and acceptance materials. Use for supporting and coordinating user acceptance testing in the UAT phase.

name: qa-unit-test-strategy
description: Sets the unit test strategy (coverage thresholds, test scope, critical path list), reviews developers' unit test plans and coverage, and blocks handover to test when necessary. Use before developer self-testing, for unit test coverage review and for UT-phase quality control.

name: release-deployment-runbook
description: Generates an executable deployment runbook: command-level steps, expected results, verification methods, pre/post checks and exception handling. Use before release execution and during deployment.

name: release-environment-mgmt
description: Manages configuration, versions and availability across multiple environments (DEV/SIT/UAT/PROD/DR) and detects environment drift. Use for environment preparation, configuration changes and environment consistency checks.

name: release-plan
description: Produces an executable, reversible, verifiable release plan: change package and artifact verification, release order and window, canary strategy, go-live checklist. Use after G5 security clearance passes, when entering release preparation.

name: rollback-runbook
description: Defines a fast, safe rollback path for a failed release: rollback point identification, command-level steps, data consistency handling, verification methods and owners. Required when drafting a release plan.

name: sdlc-context-bus
description: SDLC context bus and Agent collaboration mechanism, providing structured context passing, callback-based fixes, parallel orchestration and conditional branching.

name: sdlc-metrics
description: SDLC delivery performance metrics system. Collects Lead Time/gate interception rate/DORA metrics/Agent effectiveness and generates metrics dashboards and trend reports.

name: sdlc-ux-enhancer
description: SDLC user experience enhancements, providing a progress dashboard, gate bypass records, an Agent recommendation engine and one-click full-pipeline triggering.

name: sec-scan-review
description: Classify SAST / DAST / dependency scan results by CVSS and internal standards, identify false positives, give fix / waiver recommendations, and conclude with release / reject. Use after the build, before release, or after dependency updates.

name: sec-secure-coding-guide
description: Provides secure coding standards with good and bad examples for banking scenarios (OWASP Top 10 variants). Use before writing code, during reviews and for consultation; also checks secure coding compliance automatically.

name: sec-threat-model
description: Identifies security threats and determines mitigations through STRIDE analysis during design, covering authentication/authorization/data/input validation/logging/sessions. Use before design is finalized and for features involving authentication/data/interfaces.

name: sec-vulnerability-mgmt
description: Full vulnerability lifecycle management: discover -> grade -> assign -> fix -> verify -> close, with SLA tracking and posture reports. Use when a security vulnerability is found, for fix tracking and for periodic vulnerability assessments.

name: sod-compliance-check
description: Automatically detects segregation of duties (SoD) conflicts: role permission conflicts, gate executor vs. approver conflicts, and indirect conflicts (transitive closure). Use for gate reviews, configuration changes and audit sampling.
